title: Understanding Trap Seal Protection in Drainage Vents
description: A drainage system relies on atmospheric air pressure to maintain proper flow and protect building occupants. Every plumbing fixture requires a P-trap, which holds standing water to block hazardous sewer gases from entering living spaces. Without dedicated vent piping, draining wastewater creates a vacuum that siphons this protective water seal out of the trap. Ensuring proper vent sizing and placement per local plumbing code prevents trap siphoning, eliminates gurgling sounds, and maintains a safe, odor-free drainage system across all installed fixtures.

Understanding Trap Seal Protection in Drainage Vents

A drainage system relies on atmospheric air pressure to maintain proper flow and protect building occupants. Every plumbing fixture requires a P-trap, which holds standing water to block hazardous sewer gases from entering living spaces. Without dedicated vent piping, draining wastewater creates a vacuum that siphons this protective water seal out of the trap. Ensuring proper vent sizing and placement per local plumbing code prevents trap siphoning, eliminates gurgling sounds, and maintains a safe, odor-free drainage system across all installed fixtures.
